:::: section
## Project Reflection

These projects helped me understand that marketing is not only about creativity. It also depends on research, measurement, communication, and the ability to explain insights clearly. I learned that data becomes more valuable when it is organized in a way that helps people make decisions.

::: highlight-box
My main takeaway from these projects is that strong marketing combines customer understanding, clear communication, and measurable evidence.
:::
